info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Servicing Issue Management API
info.description: The Servicing Issue Management API is designed to facilitate the reporting and management of customer servicing issues within the banking sector. This endpoint allows users to submit new servicing issues, which can be tracked and addressed by customer support teams. Typical consumers include bank representatives and service agents who require a streamlined process for issue resolution. The API ensures efficient handling of service-related inquiries, enhancing customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create a new servicing issue in the system. Upon successful creation, relevant details of the issue will be returned.
